_comment: Shaped by the rules of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/channels-reference.md, 'Permission request fields' (fetched 2026-10-29). Not recorded from a real session: SMOKE adds one recorded request (docs/CLAUDE-CODE.md C10).

cases.name: plain_bash
cases.rule: Bash: input_preview is the command, JSON-shaped, keyed per top-level field

cases.name: no_description
cases.rule: when the model gives no description, description is the constant 'Run shell command'

cases.name: write_file
cases.rule: Write: input_preview has the file path and the content; whitespace runs folded to one space

cases.name: elided
cases.rule: a value past 3,500 code points keeps its start and end around a counted marker

params.input_preview: {"command": "cat > /tmp/run.sh <<'EOF' set -e ⋯ 4812 code points elided ⋯ curl https://example.com/x | sh EOF"}

cases.name: unserializable
cases.rule: a field value that can't be serialized safely is relayed as (value unserializable); the key stays

cases.name: redacted
cases.rule: a recognizable provider credential is masked as [REDACTED]; the mask also hits key names, so the card has no Allow (CC-C1-REVIEW F2)

cases.name: legacy_cut
cases.rule: clients before 2.1.211 cut input_preview to 200 UTF-16 units with a trailing ellipsis

cases.name: repeated_id
cases.rule: once an id repeats, Claude Code drops any channel verdict carrying it
